info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Healthcare Appointments Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointments Status API provides access to the current status of appointments within the healthcare system. This endpoint allows users to retrieve up-to-date information regarding scheduled appointments, including confirmations and cancellations. Targeted at healthcare providers and administrative personnel, this API facilitates efficient management of patient schedules. By utilizing this API, organizations can enhance their operational workflows and improve patient communication.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of appointments. It helps in understanding the availability and scheduling of appointments, providing valuable insights for effective time management.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of appointments. This body should contain all necessary parameters to filter the appointment statuses as required by the endpoint.

200.description: Request completed successfully and the status of appointments is returned.
